root_idea.summary: A root of reciprocal movement, repetition, and continued recurrence: something turns back upon itself or persists without release.
root_idea.development: The root develops from repeated movement or fluctuation to persistence and obstinacy, the tumultuous motion of sea and waves, confused speech or sounds, and figurative depth, darkness, and intensity.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form لَجَّ.
Displayed as the nominal citation form لُجَّة.
Displayed as the adjective citation form لُجِّيّ.

senses.definition: To persist obstinately in an action or course, refusing to desist; to continue in defiant wrongdoing.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences, the persistence is in a course of error or defiance, expressed with فِي and an associated affair or condition.

senses.definition: A body or expanse of water; especially the deep or fathomless part of the sea.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence uses the noun for a body of water or pool; the wider lexical range includes the deep sea and a great expanse whose limits are not seen.

senses.definition: Of a deep, vast, or fathomless sea; deep-sea.
senses.usage_conditions: A nisbah adjective associated with لُجَّة البحر, used in the Quranic expression for a deep sea.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To apply oneself constantly, perseveringly, or assiduously to an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general Form I use for sustained application to a matter, without the Quranic implication of defiant wrongdoing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persist in contention, litigation, wrangling, or opposition; to contend or quarrel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of persistence in an adversarial affair or verbal dispute.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter or embark upon the deep sea.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a ship or of embarking upon the لُجَّة, the main or fathomless sea.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wrangle, quarrel, or contend with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or relational use, including tongues persisting in disputes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to continue or persevere in a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is reported as an interpretation of the Quranic expression يُمَدُّهُمْ; the reported attribution is accompanied by doubt about the Arabic usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cry out or utter confused cries.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of people, camels, sheep, or goats producing a cry or confused clamour.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fluctuate in the bosom, or to come and go repeatedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing that repeatedly moves or recurs within someone’s breast or inner state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wrangle, quarrel, or contend with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction expressing mutual dispute.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become tumultuous and confused, with waves dashing together; of the sea, to become vast and turbulent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the sea or its waves when their movement becomes great, confused, and agitated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For voices or sounds to become confused, or to rise high and become confused.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a mixture or tumult of sounds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For darkness to become intricate, dense, and confused.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use applied to darkness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For an affair to become great and confused.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A marked figurative extension from tumultuous or confused movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a wide desert to become a sea-like scene of mirage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative poetic construction comparing the desert’s apparent expanse to a fathomless sea.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be intensely black, of an eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on the dark depth of the sea.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak indistinctly, with a heavy or defective tongue; to hesitate, reiterate, stammer, or stutter in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes speech in which its parts are not uttered plainly and consecutively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To move a morsel of food repeatedly backward and forward in the mouth while chewing it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of handling a morsel that is not readily swallowed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side or shore of a valley or sea; a rugged part of a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal geographical use distinct from the deep-sea sense of لُجَّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sword, by metaphorical association with the terror or force of the sea.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare, dialectally attributed or figurative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Voices, cries, clamour, or a confused mixture of sounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the clamour of people and sometimes of camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figuratively, a vast or fathomless expanse, including a person likened to a sea in breadth or a great expanse of mirage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphorical extension of the sea sense to breadth and apparently boundless expanses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figuratively, intense depth or blackness, especially of darkness, night, or an eye; also a deeply black animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphorical use based on the dark depth of deep water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A numerous assembly, company, troop, or congregated body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative collective use derived from the image of a great sea.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The main or principal part of an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression for the central or substantial portion of a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mirror.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare tropical use recorded as a separate nominal extension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Silver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare tropical nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who persists greatly or obstinately, refuses to turn back, or is very contentious or litigious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive epithet applicable to a human being or a horse; the feminine form is لَجُوجَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Restless fluttering of the heart that does not settle, especially from hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use developed from the notion of unrest and repeated movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Confused or indirect in expression, causing hesitation rather than clear utterance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the proverbial contrast between manifest truth and falsity that is confused in speech and action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mixture or confusion of voices or sounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of indistinct or intermingled sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who speaks indistinctly, hesitates, reiterates, stammers, or stutters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a natural heaviness or defect of speech, including a tongue that moves unclearly in the mouth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intensely black, of an eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intensely green or densely covered, of land or its herbage; compact, tall, and abundant in growth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of land whose vegetation is dense, whether or not it is tangled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Aloeswood or another aromatic wood used for fumigation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A foreign or quasi-quinqueliteral plant name with several recorded variants; its association with this root is lexical rather than a regular root derivation.
